title: JmapRequestBuilder maintains redundant call_ids HashSet
description: request.rs JmapRequestBuilder (lines 28-32): maintains a HashSet<String> parallel to the method_calls Vec solely for duplicate-id detection. RFC 8620 §3.3 maxCallsInRequest is typically 32; an O(n) linear scan over method_calls.iter().any(|c| c.2 == call_id) would be fast enough and eliminate the HashSet field plus the call_id.clone() in add_call. The dual structure silently grows with each add_call even on the success path. Suggested rewrite: remove call_ids field; replace HashSet::insert check with a linear scan of method_calls.
